scientific_integrity: Algebraic claims are proved for all dimensions; finite exact-arithmetic tests serve only as supplementary checks. Source comparisons and unresolved priority risks are recorded without claiming external certification.
scientific_limitations: The proof assumes one fixed site and independent fair binary noise; it does not cover biased noise, multiple sites, or other feedback laws.
Some older literature on linear controllability or binary linear-recursion sampling may imply components of the classification under other terminology.
The mathematical review is not an independent external validation.
title: Exact sampling and parity classes for single-site randomized XOR shift registers
